summary: John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to report a routine monthly dividend declaration for its Class I common shares at $0.1990 per share, payable May 25, 2026, to shareholders of record April 29, 2026. The filing also discloses the March 31, 2026 NAV per share of $25.08 for Class I and aggregate NAV of $467 million, along with an update on its continuous public offering of up to $2.0 billion in shares, with 18.6 million shares issued for $470 million total consideration as of April 1, 2026. This is a standard periodic disclosure by a business development company, not a special situation.
